reference: Eugene Wigner's semicircle law, Annals of Mathematics 62, 548 (1955), and Freeman Dyson's threefold way and Brownian-motion model, J. Math. Phys. 3, 140 and 1191 (1962). The tridiagonal matrix models that make a general β cheap to sample are Ioana Dumitriu and Alan Edelman, 'Matrix models for beta ensembles', J. Math. Phys. 43, 5830 (2002). The spacing forms quoted in the status line are Wigner's surmise; the exact answers are the Gaudin-Mehta determinantal formulae, Michel Mehta, Random Matrices. The gamma sampler is George Marsaglia and Wai Wan Tsang, ACM TOMS 26, 363 (2000).
equation: p(λ) ∝ ∏_{i<j} |λ_i − λ_j|^β · e^{−Σλ_i²/2};   dλ_i = √(2/β) dB_i + Σ_{j≠i} dt/(λ_i − λ_j)
limitations: Complete evidence covers only the domain in validation/RMT.md: sampler, solver and exact moments for n 24-400 and beta 0.1-12, semicircle for beta 1-12, Gaudin-Mehta spacing law at beta 1 and 2 with n 400, the printed spread of two presets, Dyson mode at 24 paths, and five complete prints.

The code samples the Dumitriu-Edelman matrix without its 1/sqrt(2), so the eigenvalue density is exp(-sum l^2/4), not the exp(-sum l^2/2) the displayed equation shows; the Dyson mode is the stationary Ornstein-Uhlenbeck version, whose drift includes -l_i/2 dt, which the displayed SDE omits.

At n 150 the local unfolding (24-gap window) biases the spacing scale: the CV agrees with Gaudin-Mehta but the pooled KS distance (0.0043, 0.0044) exceeds its bootstrap critical value (0.0027, 0.0025). The spacing-distribution claim is limited to n 400.
The status line prints the unfolded CV without an error bar and against the Wigner surmise; at beta 1 the tab's own sample resolves the surmise's 0.012 error (6.6 sigma for the GOE preset).
Finite samples from one seeded PRNG; error bars assume independent draws. Beta 4 spacings, edge statistics, beta outside 0.05-20 and the sweep plate's printed spread are not tested.
The shell's SVG raster differs from the canvas only where ticks overlap (group versus per-mark opacity) and at Dyson path ends (the SVG omits round caps); no mark moves.
remaining: Print the spacing spread through compare() with its row-bootstrap error, against the Gaudin-Mehta values 0.534 (beta 1) and 0.424 (beta 2).
Correct the displayed equation to the code's normalization (or add the 1/sqrt(2)) and show the OU drift of Dyson mode.
Add stroke-linecap="round" to the Dyson SVG polylines so the vector print matches the screen.
Extend the spacing test to beta 4 and to a global (semicircle) unfolding that removes the n 150 scale bias.

numerical.scope: Module tqli against Sturm bisection (60 matrices); exact E Tr H^2 and E Tr H^4 over 25 seeded ensembles (n 24-400, beta 0.1-12, 1000-2000 matrices each); semicircle KS convergence and one-eigenvalue-per-matrix KS tests; unfolded spacings against Fredholm-determinant Gaudin-Mehta laws at beta 1 and 2 (n 150 and 400); printed spread of two presets; Dyson OU statistics over 48 seeds.
numerical.criteria: Eigenvalues within 4 n eps ||T||; moment |z| < 4.265 (Bonferroni, 50 tests, alpha 0.001); semicircle KS below the Kolmogorov critical value at alpha 5e-5 per test and monotone convergence; n 400 spacing KS below the matrix-bootstrap 99th percentile and CV |z| < 3.662; Dyson Jacobi agreement within 8 n eps ||H||_F and stationarity and e^{-t/2} decay within |z| < 3.719.
numerical.benchmark: Closed-form moments of the tridiagonal model derived by closed-walk counting; independent Sturm-sequence and Jacobi eigenvalue solvers; the semicircle CDF; Gaudin-Mehta spacing laws evaluated as Fredholm determinants of the sine kernel (Bornemann 2010); exact Ornstein-Uhlenbeck autocorrelation of Tr H.
numerical.failureControl: chi degrees of freedom beta(n-i+1) (smallest |z| 31) and beta n (semicircle and moments fail); early QL deflation (9e7 times tolerance); gaps without unfolding over the whole spectrum (KS 0.044 and 0.059, over 30 times critical); wrong OU decay e^{-d} (|z| 24). The Wigner surmise is also rejected at beta 1.
numerical.limitations: Only the domain in validation/RMT.md; the n 150 spacing distribution disagrees through the local unfolding's scale bias; seeded PRNG samples do not prove independence.

print.scope: Five studio recipes (GUE, GOE comb, beta sweep, crystal, Dyson) through dist/studio.html with an auditRead() hook at 2400 px on the long side: every SVG tick rectangle and polyline vertex, the fallback PNG, a displaced control, and recipe and spectra before and after export.
print.criteria: Studio spectra within solver tolerance of the Node run and of independent Sturm or Jacobi eigenvalues; printed spread equal to Node; SVG coordinates within 0.00501 px and every fill equal; PNG channels within 1 of an independent painting; displaced painting fails; state unchanged.
print.benchmark: Geometry and inks rebuilt in the page from independently computed eigenvalues with an independent layout and color rule.
print.failureControl: One-pixel displaced painting must differ on at least 100 channels (it differs on 2.2 to 5.1 million).
print.limitations: Five recipes, grain off, one Chromium build; the vector RIP raster is recorded, not asserted, and differs where ticks overlap and at Dyson path ends.

domain.parameters: Tridiagonal sampler and solver: n 24-400, beta 0.1-12 (eigenvalue check 0.05-20); semicircle beta 1-12; spacing law beta 1 and 2 at n 400 (CV also at n 140-260); Dyson paths 24, 480 slices, span 24; prints: the five recipes in validation/results/rmt-science.json.
domain.conditions: Seeded Dumitriu-Edelman matrices in the tab's normalization (N(0,2) diagonal, chi_{beta(n-i)} subdiagonal, density exp(-sum l^2/4)); stationary GOE Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process for Dyson mode; grain off for prints; exports preserve recipe and spectra.
domain.resolution: Matrix sizes and sample sizes as listed (1000-3000 matrices per ensemble, 48 Dyson seeds); spacing CDF on 1001 points over [0, 5]; prints 2400 x 2400, 1920 x 2400, 2400 x 1920 and 2400 x 1600 px.
domain.precision: Binary64 in module and references; eigenvalues within 4 n eps ||T||; RGBA8 raster; SVG rounded to 0.01 px; Node and Chromium versions recorded.
